questions.question: What does the app do?
questions.answer: Mirra is a browser/SVG visual workspace with a local board library and a separate D1-backed hosted layer for permissions, comments, presence and collaboration. It does not claim full Miro parity.

questions.question: How do I run it locally?
questions.answer: Use Node24+. In source/, npm run dev serves the device-only editor at loopback4173. For cloud development, in source/cloud/ run npm run install:ci, node ../../tools/migrate-local.mjs, then npm run dev -- --port 5173 --host 127.0.0.1. Root npm test requires cloud dependencies installed.

questions.question: Where would I change feature X?
questions.answer: For a table field: src/tables.mjs validation first, public/table-editor.mjs UI next, src/table-drafts.mjs recovery, then typed-cell/permission/undo tests. Theme changes start at public/design.css; routes start at src/navigation.mjs or cloud/app and the service/method exports. Synchronize root copies before cloud build.

questions.question: What is stored in the browser?
questions.answer: localStorage contains versioned board/library JSON, scoped recovery drafts, creation intents and a seven-day sidebar preference. sessionStorage contains the tab client id and table/text/title/property/voting recovery. These contain user content, not service credentials.
